title: Loch Lomond
description: The Scottish song, for 2 to 4 singers: two verses, each with "O ye'll tak' the high road". The soprano sings the melody, the alto sings the words beneath it, the tenor answers the tune's own phrases in the chorus, and the bass holds the roots like a drone. Slow and tender in the verses, a little brisker in the chorus.
